name: io.github.chrischall/gemini-mcp
description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) image models.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-3.1-flash-image)

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Default directory for generated images (default: current working directory)

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_INPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against
